item.title: Mass transit service across NYC, Tri-State area slowly restoring in wake of blizzard
item.description: The blizzard has impacted everything from New York City subways and buses, the Long Island Rail Road, Metro-North, New Jersey Transit and ferries.

item.title: Over 70 people killed in attempt to capture Mexican cartel leader and violent aftermath
item.description: More than 70 people died in Mexico's attempt to capture the notorious leader of the Jalisco New Generation Cartel and the violent aftermath of his death.

item.title: NJ Transit recovers from historic snowfall, announces service updates for Tuesday
item.description: New details were released about New Jersey Transit's plan to get back up and running after a major blizzard slammed the Garden State Sunday into Monday.

item.title: Multiple NYPD officers hit with snowballs, injured in Washington Square Park
item.description: Police say officers responded to the park around 4 p.m. on Monday for a report of multiple individuals on top of a roof inside the park.

item.title: Snow plow driver rescues lost dogs during height of blizzard in Babylon
item.description: A Department of Public Works employee was out plowing roads in Babylon when he spotted the pooches running down the westbound side of Sunrise Highway.

item.title: NYC Public Schools to reopen Tuesday after historic blizzard despite opposition
item.description: Cleanup efforts are underway in New York City, and public schools will reopen for in-person learning Tuesday, in the aftermath of a blizzard that battered the region.

item.title: Blizzard slams Long Island with snow, strong winds; LIRR to resume partial service Tuesday
item.description: The storm snarled mass transit, including the Long Island Rail Road, which announced it will limited resume service at 4 a.m. on Tuesday.

item.title: AccuWeather: Cold and breezy
item.description: Winds ease Tuesday, though conditions remain breezy and cold with highs near 31.

item.title: US women's gold medal-winning team declines invitation from Trump to attend State of Union address
item.description: The U.S. women's hockey gold medal-winning team has politely declined an invitation from President Donald Trump to attend his State of the Union address on Tuesday.

item.title: Aisha Dee reveals all about her Hulu series 'Watching You'
item.description: "It affects you in a way that's really unexpected." Aisha Dee unpacks the drama in "Watching You." The psychological thriller is streaming now on Hulu and Hulu on Disney+.
